args.note: I've written cold-read.md. The strongest pages are the debt-on-your-birthday hook (p12), the 62% reported vs 18% delivered reveal (p32) and Ada meeting her mother (p46). I'd put it down on p8 in the opening, p41 in Issue 03 (four strangers at once, and Lock's offer never answered) and p60 in Issue 06 (the civics speech), and p60 is the page that would lose the whole class. Three things I couldn't account for: the 2099 frame, TJ and the lake never come back; "TOMAS PHANTUM" appears on p63 with no explanation; and the debt drops from 418,107 to 314,159 off-page. The keys in Issue 02 contradict each other, and the names Lina Vey, Pilar Veyra and Leona Veyra are easy to mix up. A skeptical reader may take the many balanced aphorism lines as a sign the book is AI-written. Verdicts: Issues 01, 02, 04 and 05 yes; Issues 03 and 06 no.
